text:
IncidentBot: paging #incidents -> on-call SRE (Jordan (SRE))

Jordan (SRE): got the page, looking. Saw spike in 90s p50 latency and 5xxs on the canary fleet.

Alex T.: metrics look off on canary-1 and canary-2 right after the deploy at 12:14 UTC, error rate ~7% 5xx, client timeouts up.

Maria L.: rolling forward a feature flag at 12:13, might be correlated. Flag: `quick-embed` rolled to 10% canary.

Jordan (SRE): canary failing health checks. I'm going to pause traffic and start rollback. @DeployBot can you stop the canary traffic?

DeployBot: received stop request for deployment id dpl-2026-03-15-12:13, initiating traffic drain.

Kyle P.: if it's the flag we can flip it off too; `feature.toggle.quick-embed = false`?

Maria L.: I'm toggling from the console now. switching to `false` in 3...2...1 :gear: 

Maria L.: done. flag reverted. Observability: error rate dipped 20% immediately but p95 latency still high.

Jordan (SRE): rolling traffic off canary hosts and promoting rollback on control plane. Executing manual rollback to image `redwood/runtime:2026-03-10-a1`.

Jordan (SRE): running pool drain command:
```
# drain canary pool
redwoodctl route update --pool canary --weight 0 --wait
```

Jordan (SRE): confirming pods replaced with previous image, doing a canary smoke against `/healthz` and `/v1/generate`

Alex T.: curl health check on one instance: `curl -sS http://10.11.5.23:8080/healthz` -> `{"status":"ok","uptime":"3m"}`

Alex T.: smoke generate:
```
curl -sS -X POST http://10.11.5.23:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":4}'
```
-> 200 OK, response tokens present.

Jordan (SRE): rolling verification across 6 hosts in canary pool. If all good will reintroduce traffic gradually.

IncidentBot: alert suppressed for `canary-failure` while rollback in progress.

Maria L.: quick note: initial rollout included a small change to async batching. That path might have triggered kernel select that degrades small requests. Logging that for follow-up.

Kyle P.: telemetry shows increased queue depth on GPU workers during the bad image window. Might be batching config mismatch.

Jordan (SRE): all 6 canary hosts are back on `2026-03-10-a1` image, health checks green. Starting gradual traffic ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 2m pauses.

Jordan (SRE): ramping to 10% now. watching error rate and latency dashboards: https://redwood.observability/dashboards/deploys/canary-traffic

Alex T.: at 10% error rate down to baseline (~0.3%), p95 back to normal.

Jordan (SRE): ramping to 30%.

Maria L.: will open a bug for batching kernel selection and add reproduction steps from the canary logs.

ProductOps: customer impact? any reported user-facing failures?

Alex T.: we saw a small number of customer requests failing (100s of requests across a region) but no major account impact. No paged customers yet.

ProductOps: please add a short customer-facing note in the incident tracker: "brief interruption to inference for a subset of canary traffic; rollback executed; no ongoing impact". I'll prep comms if needed.

Jordan (SRE): final ramp to 100% completed at 12:29 UTC. monitoring for 15m before closing thread.

IncidentBot: Incident timeline: root deploy 12:13 UTC -> flag flip 12:13 UTC -> canary errors detected 12:15 UTC -> rollback start 12:16 UTC -> rollback complete 12:29 UTC.

Maria L.: postmortem owners: Maria + Eng-Runtime. I'll include logs, batching config diffs, and recommended smoke tests for future canaries.

Kyle P.: action item: add an automated pre-canine smoke that exercises small-token requests and the new batching path.

Jordan (SRE): on-call handoff to next SRE in 20m — @Jordan (SRE) to @Alex T. for verification after cooling window.

Alex T.: ack. Will watch the dashboards and tag the postmortem draft once logs are collected.

Jordan (SRE): closing slack thread for now, will update incident tracker when postmortem is ready. :white_check_mark:
